profile_text.body:
Salesforce's website at slack.com/features/ai presents Slack AI as a productivity tool. The company describes Slack AI as able to summarize chats, search files, take meeting notes, translate conversations, and automate workflows. It says Slackbot is a personal AI agent that understands a user's workspace, helps prepare for meetings, analyzes reports, and creates project briefs. The company states that customer data is not used to train large language models, and that the LLMs are hosted within Slack's AWS virtual private cloud. It also describes Slack as the conversational UI for Agentforce, with agents built with Agentforce able to run in Slack channels, threads, and direct messages.

Salesforce's AI products include Slack AI, Tableau AI (Einstein), and Salesforce Einstein / Agentforce. Slack AI is embedded in messaging. Tableau AI (Einstein) is described as BI embedded AI with natural language queries, CRM data integration, and Trust Layer governance. Salesforce Einstein / Agentforce is described as CRM-embedded AI plus agents. The company says AI features are available across all paid Slack plans.

Salesforce is a public company founded in 1999 and headquartered in San Francisco, CA, USA. It trades as CRM and has SEC CIK 0001108524. Its most recent 10-K, for the period ended January 31, 2026, reports revenue of $41,525,000,000. The company is associated with 281 legal exposure matters in California. Six MCP servers are listed for Salesforce: ai.cirra/salesforce-mcp, ai.smithery/kodey-ai-salesforce-mcp, ai.smithery/kodey-ai-salesforce-mcp-kodey, ai.smithery/kodey-ai-salesforce-mcp-minimal, ai.smithery/kodey-ai-salesforce-mcp-server, and cloud.serpent/salesforce-devops.
